messages:
olivia: Heads-up: rolling out 'tiered-prefetch-handshake' to canary pools now. Early canary shows p50 ~12% down, p99 ~23% down, token cost ~9% savings on chat traces. No model changes, runtime-only. :sparkles:

ci-bot: canary report (canary-3 -> prod):
- p50: 90ms -> 79ms (-12.2%)
- p99: 440ms -> 340ms (-22.7%)
- token cost: $0.0090 -> $0.0082 (-8.9%)
- errors: 0.017% -> 0.018%

ryan: what's the technical delta? more prefetch or batching tweaks?

olivia: short version: a handshake between proxy and runtime so prefetches are tiered (in-process hint -> async remote fetch), plus an adaptive microbatch hold that coalesces tiny requests only if handshake predicts a hot-prefix will be served. This reduces duplicate remote KV hops and avoids widening large batches.

megan: rollback/opt-out? we should add a one-liner for ops and CS.

olivia: feature-flag `runtime.tiered_prefetch_handshake` (per-pool). Rollback: `POST /release/flags/runtime.tiered_prefetch_handshake/disable` body `{\"pool\":\"<pool>\"}`. Opt-out for tenants: `runtime.disable_tiered_prefetch=true`. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/tiered-prefetch-handshake

deploy-bot: feature enabled on canary pools: gpu-us-west-1a, gpu-eu-west-1a. Rolling to more pools if green in 20m.

infra: quick canary check we used:
```
python infra/metrics_diff.py --metric p99_latency --from canary-3 --to prod --group pool
```

ryan: draft blurb for ops/CS: "Deployed tiered-prefetch-handshake: p50 -12%, p99 -23%, token cost -9%. Opt-out: runtime.disable_tiered_prefetch=true. Runbook: https://go/redwood/runbooks/tiered-prefetch-handshake" :thumbsup:

olivia: thanks everyone 12 big props to prefetch + microbatch teams, will post graphs later. :party_parrot:
